gbm_population_evidence.quote: HPV-Positive Oropharyngeal Squamous Cell Carcinoma; Oropharyngeal Squamous Cell Carcinoma; Head and Neck Cancer
Histologically confirmed squamous cell carcinoma of the oropharynx that is HPV-positive
In Participants With Recurrent Or Progressive Glioblastoma

gbm_population_flag.reason: Official title names recurrent/progressive glioblastoma, but conditions, arms, interventions and eligibility describe only HPV-positive oropharyngeal cancer; title treated as a registry error.

candidate_evidence.quote: NAI 1.2 mg administered subcutaneously as part of the experimental treatment regimen.
Nab-paclitaxel 100 mg/m² administered intravenously during neoadjuvant treatment cycles.

treatment_setting_evidence.quote: No prior definitive treatment for the current OPSCC.

role_evidence.quote: Participants will receive neoadjuvant nogapendekin alfa inbakicept (NAI), hAd5-HPV vaccine (IBRX-042), and nab-paclitaxel followed by de-intensified intensity-modulated radiation therapy (IMRT) with concurrent cisplatin, and post-radiation NAI and IBRX-042.
Nab-paclitaxel 100 mg/m² administered intravenously during neoadjuvant treatment cycles.
IBRX-042 administered subcutaneously as part of the experimental treatment regimen.
Cisplatin 40 mg/m² administered intravenously concurrently with radiation therapy.

source_quote.quote: Histologically confirmed squamous cell carcinoma of the oropharynx that is HPV-positive (p16 immunohistochemistry positive and/or HPV DNA positive).
Early efficacy signals such as clearance of circulating tumor HPV DNA (using the NavDx® assay) will also be assessed to gauge biomarker response.

coder_notes: Record body is HPV-positive oropharyngeal cancer; only the official title mentions recurrent or progressive glioblastoma (with bevacizumab, tumour treatment fields, PD-L1 t-haNK, none of which are registered interventions). Coded not_glioblastoma and flagged uncertain for adjudication; likely a registry text mix-up. Candidate fields filled as if the record were eligible. HPV biomarker not candidate-matched because the HPV vaccine is an excluded intervention type, not a candidate (HPV targeting by the vaccine noted). Nab-paclitaxel and NAI treated as two investigational agents (experimental_combination).
